title: Get a permit to run a function or event on council property
what: Get the council's permit before running a function or entertainment event on council property or another public place.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 165, 27 Aug 2010, Gazette No. 178, 30 Nov 2018); the amendments were not read.
